import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
variables = {}

for instruction in text.split(";"):
    instruction = instruction.strip()
    if not instruction:
        continue

    match = re.fullmatch(r"([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*<-\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*|-?\d+)", instruction)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid instruction: {instruction}")

    target, source = match.groups()
    variables[target] = variables[source] if source in variables else int(source)

order = "a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p TMP".split()
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {variables[name]}" for name in order))
